title: DeepSeek considers doubling latest funding round to up to $15 billion, sources say
key_facts: DeepSeek is considering expanding its latest funding round to as much as 100 billion yuan ($14.9 billion), double the earlier target (CNBC, citing people familiar).
Strong interest from state-backed funds, investment arms of listed Chinese companies and venture capital firms.
DeepSeek is vetting investors closely, turning away private funds raised from individuals and limiting the pool largely to government and corporate funds.
The fundraising process remains fluid and the amount could change before talks conclude.
Bloomberg reported earlier Tuesday that DeepSeek is close to securing at least 80 billion yuan, with Tencent and CATL among the largest backers, and is eyeing an IPO in early 2027.
CATL, Geely Auto, Monolith Management and Loyal Valley Capital have committed capital, one person told CNBC.
quote_evidence: The fundraising process remains fluid, and the amount could still change before talks conclude.
CATL, Geely Auto and investment managers Monolith Management and Loyal Valley Capital have committed capital in the latest round, one of the people told CNBC.
why_it_matters_hint: Round could double to about $14.9bn with state and corporate backers; amount still fluid.
